Glossary of biology.fact: Its main function is to deliver the acetyl group to the citric acid cycle (Krebs cycle) to be oxidized for energy production.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: aerobic _____ of surviving and growing in the presence of oxygen
Glossary of biology.fact: aerobic Capable of surviving and growing in the presence of oxygen.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: animal Any member of a clade of multicellular eukaryotic organisms belonging to the biological kingdom _____
Glossary of biology.fact: animal Any member of a clade of multicellular eukaryotic organisms belonging to the biological kingdom Animalia.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Archaea One of the three recognized domains of organisms, the other two being _____ and Eukaryota
Glossary of biology.fact: antibiotic Also called an antibacterial. A type of antimicrobial drug used in the treatment and prevention of bacterial infections.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: autotroph _____ used interchangeably with primary producer
Glossary of biology.fact: autotroph Sometimes used interchangeably with primary producer.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: biodiversity A contraction of "biological diversity" generally referring to the variety and variability of life on _____
Glossary of biology.fact: biodiversity A contraction of "biological diversity" generally referring to the variety and variability of life on Earth.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: biomass _____ matter derived from living or recently living organisms
Glossary of biology.fact: biomass Organic matter derived from living or recently living organisms.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: biome Any very large ecological area on the _____'s surface containing fauna and flora (animals and plants) adapting to their environment
Glossary of biology.fact: biome Any very large ecological area on the Earth's surface containing fauna and flora (animals and plants) adapting to their environment.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: biomolecule _____ and ions that are present in organisms, essential to some typically biological process such as cell division, morphogenesis, or development
Glossary of biology.fact: biomolecule Molecules and ions that are present in organisms, essential to some typically biological process such as cell division, morphogenesis, or development.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: cell plate _____ in the cell's center, it fuses with the parental plasma membrane, creating a new cell wall that enables cell division
Glossary of biology.fact: cell plate Grown in the cell's center, it fuses with the parental plasma membrane, creating a new cell wall that enables cell division.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: cilia circadian rhythm citric acid cycle Also called the _____ cycle and tricarboxylic acid cycle (TCA)
Glossary of biology.fact: cilia circadian rhythm citric acid cycle Also called the Krebs cycle and tricarboxylic acid cycle (TCA).

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: In addition, the cycle provides the chemical precursors for certain amino acids as well as the reducing agent _____ that is used in numerous other biochemical reactions
Glossary of biology.fact: In addition, the cycle provides the chemical precursors for certain amino acids as well as the reducing agent NADH that is used in numerous other biochemical reactions.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Many organisms, such as bacteria, insects, and _____, are capable of naturally producing clones through asexual reproduction
Glossary of biology.fact: Many organisms, such as bacteria, insects, and plants, are capable of naturally producing clones through asexual reproduction.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: cryobiology The branch of biology that studies the effects of low temperatures on living things within _____'s cryosphere or in laboratory experiments
Glossary of biology.fact: cryobiology The branch of biology that studies the effects of low temperatures on living things within Earth's cryosphere or in laboratory experiments.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: It is an interdisciplinary field that combines concepts from biology, geography, and _____ science
Glossary of biology.fact: It is an interdisciplinary field that combines concepts from biology, geography, and Earth science.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: ecotype _____ called an ecospecies
Glossary of biology.fact: ecotype Sometimes called an ecospecies.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: efferent _____ or conducting outwards or away from something (for nerves, the central nervous system; for blood vessels, the organ supplied)
Glossary of biology.fact: efferent Conducted or conducting outwards or away from something (for nerves, the central nervous system; for blood vessels, the organ supplied).

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: genus gizzard An organ found in the digestive tract of some animals, including archosaurs (pterosaurs, crocodiles, alligators, and _____, including birds), earthworms, some gastropods, some fish, and some crustaceans
Glossary of biology.fact: genus gizzard An organ found in the digestive tract of some animals, including archosaurs (pterosaurs, crocodiles, alligators, and dinosaurs, including birds), earthworms, some gastropods, some fish, and some crustaceans.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: invertebrate A group of animals that have no backbone, unlike animals such as reptiles, amphibians, fish, birds, and _____, which all have a backbone
Glossary of biology.fact: invertebrate A group of animals that have no backbone, unlike animals such as reptiles, amphibians, fish, birds, and mammals, which all have a backbone.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Closely related to DNA, RNA molecules serve in a wide variety of essential biological roles, including coding, decoding, regulating, and _____, as well as functioning as signaling molecules
Glossary of biology.fact: Closely related to DNA, RNA molecules serve in a wide variety of essential biological roles, including coding, decoding, regulating, and expressing genes, as well as functioning as signaling molecules.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: An estimated _____ distinct animal species currently exist
Glossary of biology.fact: An estimated 7 million distinct animal species currently exist.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: endogenous (of a substance or process) _____ from within a system (such as an organism, tissue, or cell), as with endogenous cannabinoids and circadian rhythms
Glossary of biology.fact: endogenous (of a substance or process) Originating from within a system (such as an organism, tissue, or cell), as with endogenous cannabinoids and circadian rhythms.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: evolutionary biology The subfield of biology that studies evolution and the evolutionary processes that produced the diversity of life on _____ from a hypothesized single common ancestor
Glossary of biology.fact: evolutionary biology The subfield of biology that studies evolution and the evolutionary processes that produced the diversity of life on Earth from a hypothesized single common ancestor.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: exogenous (of a substance or process) _____ outside of or external to a system (such as an organism, tissue, or cell), as with drugs and many pathogens
Glossary of biology.fact: exogenous (of a substance or process) Originating outside of or external to a system (such as an organism, tissue, or cell), as with drugs and many pathogens.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: genetic variation _____ of genomes between members of species, or between groups of species thriving in different parts of the world as a result of genetic mutation
Glossary of biology.fact: genetic variation Variations of genomes between members of species, or between groups of species thriving in different parts of the world as a result of genetic mutation.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Among the many extant invertebrate phyla are the _____, Mollusca, Annelida, Nematoda, and Arthropoda
Glossary of biology.fact: Among the many extant invertebrate phyla are the Cnidaria, Mollusca, Annelida, Nematoda, and Arthropoda.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: isotonic solution _____ to two solutions having the same osmotic pressure across a semipermeable membrane
Glossary of biology.fact: isotonic solution Refers to two solutions having the same osmotic pressure across a semipermeable membrane.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: kingdom _____ cycle See citric acid cycle
Glossary of biology.fact: kingdom Krebs cycle See citric acid cycle.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: light-independent reactions _____ cycle
Glossary of biology.fact: light-independent reactions See Calvin cycle.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: macroevolution _____ on a scale of separated gene pools
Glossary of biology.fact: macroevolution Evolution on a scale of separated gene pools. Macroevolutionary studies focus on change that occurs at or above the level of species, in contrast with microevolution, which refers to smaller evolutionary changes (typically described as changes in allele frequencies) within a species or population.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: macronutrient _____ needed in large amounts which provide calories or energy
Glossary of biology.fact: macronutrient Nutrients needed in large amounts which provide calories or energy. Nutrients are substances needed for growth, metabolism, and for other body functions.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: multicellular _____ or consisting of more than one cell, as opposed to being unicellular
Glossary of biology.fact: multicellular Having or consisting of more than one cell, as opposed to being unicellular.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Despite comprising nearly _____ of the gas in the Earth's atmosphere, diatomic nitrogen is metabolically useless to all but a few microorganisms, known as diazotrophs
Glossary of biology.fact: Despite comprising nearly 80% of the gas in the Earth's atmosphere, diatomic nitrogen is metabolically useless to all but a few microorganisms, called diazotrophs.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Fossils are the remains or traces of organisms that lived in the geological past and have been preserved in the _____'s crust
Glossary of biology.fact: Fossils are the remains or traces of organisms that lived in the geological past and have been preserved in the Earth's crust.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Photosynthesis supplies the majority of the energy necessary for life on _____
Glossary of biology.fact: Photosynthesis supplies the majority of the energy necessary for life on Earth.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: piliferous _____ hair placebo A substance or treatment of no intended therapeutic value
Glossary of biology.fact: piliferous Bearing hair placebo A substance or treatment of no intended therapeutic value.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: polyploidy _____ or containing more than two complete sets of chromosomes
Glossary of biology.fact: polyploidy Having or containing more than two complete sets of chromosomes.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: unicellular _____ or consisting of only one cell, as opposed to being multicellular
Glossary of biology.fact: unicellular Having or consisting of only one cell, as opposed to being multicellular.

Glossary of biology.subject: Health & Medicine
Glossary of biology.question: Despite comprising nearly 80% of the gas in the _____'s atmosphere, diatomic nitrogen is metabolically useless to all but a few microorganisms, known as diazotrophs
Glossary of biology.fact: Despite comprising nearly 80% of the gas in the Earth's atmosphere, diatomic nitrogen is metabolically useless to all but a few microorganisms, called diazotrophs. Nitrogen fixation is essential to all life on Earth because fixed inorganic nitrogenous compounds are required for the biosynthesis of all nitrogen-containing organic compounds, including amino acids and nucleic acids.
